reference.citation: Fisher RA (1925) one-way analysis of variance. Reference impls: scipy.stats.f_oneway and base R stats::oneway.test(var.equal=TRUE). Data: vertical-GRF dynamic range (PhysioMoCap::grfLandmarks) in healthy controls vs four lower-limb pathology classes, GaitRec (Horsak et al. 2020).
reference.description: re-computes the one-way ANOVA omnibus F of the vertical-GRF dynamic range across the five gait classes with scipy.stats.f_oneway and base R oneway.test(var.equal=TRUE) and confirms oneWayAnova reproduces base R bit-for-bit and scipy to machine precision; also reports the control/pathology mean ratio and the group sizes
